name: transport_loss__robot_host
regression: DDS disappearance representative of a NIC/interface mismatch: CycloneDDS bound to a missing interface leaves every GO2 topic advertised with no data (HELIX docs/GO2_FIELD_NOTES.md section 1).
initial_conditions: Synthetic GO2 + HELIX run (6.5 s): /nav/cmd_vel at 20 Hz commands 0 m/s, then 0.15 m/s from t=2 s; HELIX hold published at 10 Hz, never asserted; odometry and lowstate at 20 Hz from the robot host, whose clock is 1.734 s ahead of the payload.
injected_fault: Every topic from the robot host (odometry, lowstate) is silent for 1.5 s from t=3.0 s while the graph still advertises their publishers.
